args.prompt: A sprite kit for a cute 2D pixel art game background: exactly 8 separate objects arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, each object fully visible, well separated with plenty of empty space around it, none touching or overlapping. Soft pastel 16-bit pixel art with hard square chunky pixels, simple flat shading with one highlight tone and one shadow tone, light from the top left, NO dark outlines (soft background art), no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else. Same warm pastel palette family as the reference drawing (lavender, pink and yellow). Theme: LOLLIPOP FOREST. The 8 objects are: (1) a giant yellow swirl lollipop tree, (2) a giant pink swirl lollipop tree, (3) a giant mint-green swirl lollipop tree, (4) a red and white candy cane post, (5) a round cookie hill with chocolate chips, (6) a round gumdrop bush in pastel colors, (7) a stack of two wrapped candies, (8) a small cotton candy cloud.
